tasks.task: I need to grant our new support staff member read-only access today before end-of-day. Please create a verified viewer account in the `users` collection for email `support.viewer@northwindlabs.com` with name `Support Viewer`, then confirm the account exists and has role `viewer` (policy: viewers must not have admin/operator role).

success_criteria: Step 0 returns an auth context where `context.auth_record.role` is `admin` (eligible to create users).
Step 1 returns a newly created `users` record with `email` = `support.viewer@northwindlabs.com` and `role` = `viewer`.
Step 2 returns the same record id as Step 1 and shows `role` = `viewer` (not `admin` or `operator`).

tasks.task: I need to onboard a new operator today, but they must be able to log in immediately under the instance policy (users require onlyVerified=true). Create the user for Noah Patel (noah.patel@northwindlabs.com) with role=operator, and if the users schema supports it, mark them verified; otherwise, confirm what fields are actually available and return the created user’s details (id/email/name/role) so I can complete verification through the correct mechanism before end of day.

success_criteria: Step 2 (get_collection_schema for 'users') shows the actual available user fields and does not include an updatable field named 'verified'.
Step 3 creates a users record for email noah.patel@northwindlabs.com with role 'operator' and returns a new record id.
Step 4 fetches the same record id and shows email=noah.patel@northwindlabs.com, name=Noah Patel, role=operator.

tasks.task: I need to verify that the admin account for Mia Chen is still active and audited correctly before end-of-day. Please find the user record for mia.chen@northwindlabs.com, update her display name to exactly "Mia Chen (Northwind Labs)", and then confirm the change by re-fetching the record. Constraint: only update the single matching user and include the verification + role fields in the confirmation output.

success_criteria: Step 2 returns exactly one matching user in items and provides a non-empty items.0.id for mia.chen@northwindlabs.com.
Step 3 updates that user so the returned record has name exactly "Mia Chen (Northwind Labs)".
Step 4 fetches the same id from step 2 and shows name exactly "Mia Chen (Northwind Labs)" with role="admin" and verified=true.
